risk.title: Risk explanation
risk.subtitle: How the score is built: every factor's contribution, compared with the student's grade cohort.
risk.totalHint: Contributions add up exactly to the score.
risk.explainer: Each factor's risk (0–100) is multiplied by its weight; factors without data are left out and the remaining weights are rescaled. “Against cohort” shows the points above (+) or below (−) a typical student in the same grade.
risk.empty: No risk score yet. It appears after the first recompute with grades or attendance.

unavailable.title: The tutor is unavailable right now
unavailable.body: We can't reach the tutor service at the moment. Your classes and grades are unaffected — please try again a little later.

errors.unavailable: The tutor couldn't be reached. Your message was kept — try sending it again in a moment.
errors.session_expired: This conversation has ended. Your next message starts a new one.
errors.pii_blocked: Your message wasn't sent because it seems to contain personal details (like a name, phone number or email). Remove them and try again.
errors.rate_limited: You're sending messages quickly. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.invalid: That message couldn't be sent. Check it and try again.

mastery.title: Concept mastery
mastery.subtitle: Pick a class to see which concepts it is struggling with. Mastery is estimated from students' work with the AI tutor, so it only appears for concepts a student has actually practised.

noClasses.title: No classes yet
noClasses.body: This school has no classes set up, so there is nothing to show. Classes are created in the school's setup.

noStudents.title: No students in this class
noStudents.body: Nobody is enrolled in this class yet, so there is no mastery to show.

unavailable.title: Mastery is unavailable right now
unavailable.body: We can't reach the AI service that holds mastery data at the moment. Nothing has been lost — please try again a little later.

empty.title: No mastery data for this class yet
empty.body: Mastery only exists after students use the AI tutor. No student in this class has practised a concept with the tutor yet, so there is nothing to measure — this does not mean they are behind.

summary.title: Where {className} is weakest
summary.subtitle: Concepts ranked by class average, weakest first. Averages count only students who have been assessed on the concept.

grid.title: Students × concepts
grid.unassessed: {count, plural, one {# student has} other {# students have}} no tutor attempts yet.
grid.note: "No data" means not yet assessed, not zero mastery.

legend2.title: How to read the colours
legend2.body: Each cell is the estimated chance the student has mastered the concept. A dashed cell means the student hasn't attempted it yet — that is not the same as a low score, and it is left out of the class average.

aiUsage.title: AI usage and quality
aiUsage.subtitle: This school's AI spend this month against its budget, and how the evaluation suite is scoring.

unavailable.title: AI service unavailable
unavailable.body: Usage figures can't be loaded right now. Try again shortly.

nominal.title: Nominal figures — no live AI model yet
nominal.body: Every AI answer this month came from the built-in test model, not a paid provider. The spend shown is list-price arithmetic over test traffic; no money has been charged.

discretionary.name: Discretionary
discretionary.body: Tutoring, matching, essay coaching, practice and copilot. Stops at 100%; admins are warned at 80%.

essential.name: Essential
essential.body: Classification, extraction, translation and summaries — risk explanations, parent messages and translations. Never switched off by a tutor overrun.

derivation.title: How the budget was worked out
derivation.floorBelow: {seats} students × {perSeat} = {computed} a month, which is below the {floor} floor, so the floor applies.
derivation.explicit: {cap} a month — set explicitly for this school.
derivation.essentialExplicit: Essential pool: {cap} — set explicitly for this school.
derivation.noSeatsWhy: No student count has been reported to the AI service for this school yet, so the per-student budget ($0.10 per student a month) cannot apply yet.

evals.title: Evaluation quality
evals.subtitle: The latest run of each evaluation suite. A run without a live AI model checks the plumbing only and says nothing about answer quality.

empty.body: Results appear here after the evaluation suite has run.
